name: Old Woman in a Bottle
shortDescription: A constantly complaining old woman is given magical chances to improve her home, but each new blessing only gives her something else to complain about.
longDescription: An old woman lives alone inside a bottle-shaped house and complains about it constantly. When a kind fairy hears her, she teaches the woman a magical instruction: clap her hands twice and turn around three times. The bottle becomes a small house, but the woman soon decides it is too small. The fairy transforms it into a much larger house, yet the woman complains that it is dark and dirty. After one final clap-and-spin transformation, she finds herself back inside the bottle, learning too late that she failed to recognise the blessings she had been given.
